Fernando Pessoa, Poetry.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/fernando-pessoa/poetry

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Fernando Pessoa, the author, died 1935.

First publication of the text used: 1918 to 1923 (SE colophon: 'Poetry was compiled from poetry published between 1918 and 1923 by Fernando Pessoa.')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the Standard Ebooks rights statement says the text is in the US public domain, and the text was compiled from poems first published between 1918 and 1923, all before 1931, so it is public domain there.
- Country of origin: the facts do not say in which country the text was first published. The possible countries are the United Kingdom, Ireland, the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India, South Africa and Portugal. Each has a term of life + 70 years or less for these deaths, and the United States rule above applies there. The last to die did so in 1935, so the text is public domain in each of them by 1 January 2006.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."
